name: about-bento
title: About Bento
description: An about-us block: a centred headline over a grid of four cards. A large dark card states the mission beside a green growth stat, a small status tile and a wide violet community banner.
use: A marketing site needs a compact about block that pairs a mission statement with one impressive metric.
avoid: All copy and numbers are hardcoded, so every word must be edited in the file before use.
a11y: The community banner looks clickable but is a plain div with no link, button role or focus style. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark section with a centred white headline and two-line subtitle, then a four-card bento: a large dark statement card with a violet pill, a tall green 450% stat card, a small near-black tile and a wide violet community strip with a round arrow.
behaves: The layout is mostly still; the arrow on the community card is a pointer target, and hovering the statement card slowly spins the faint star behind its text.
customise: All text, the 450% figure, the 80% bar width, the star shape and card colours are written inside the component, so changes need a source edit.
weight: light: Static markup and CSS transitions; no script runs after mount.
